knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The lesson says to answer questions and follow the group's rules on promotion when business posts are not allowed. Posting anyway (option 0) and messaging every member privately (option 2) are both named errors.

The lesson requires written consent before publication, and the cropping or blurring of identifying details is applied in addition to consent. A belief that the photo looks professional (option 1) and a promise to share it (option 2) are not consent.

The lesson requires sender identification and a working unsubscribe, checked against current ACMA guidance under the Spam Act 2003 (Cth). A discount code alone (option 0) and an assumption of consent from a past conversation (option 1) are not sufficient.

practicalCriteria: Learner reads a supplied set of group rules and writes a reply to a member's question that complies with the rules and does not promote the business where promotion is not allowed.
Learner prepares a before-and-after photo from a supplied job, showing a consent record, crop or blur of identifying details, and removal of location data.
Learner drafts an opt-in sign-up with a separate unticked choice, sender identification and an unsubscribe step, and lists the checks made against current ACMA guidance.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Group rules record and the compliant reply
Written consent record and the prepared photo
Opt-in sign-up draft with the ACMA guidance checks noted
stopWorkCriteria: Learner publishes a customer photo or details without written consent
Learner adds a person to an email list without an opt-in
Learner advertises licensed work the business does not hold the licence for
